subject: FY25 Budget and Presentation Calendar Planning
overview: The School Committee reviewed the draft FY25 budget cycle calendar and the schedule of administrative reports and presentations through June 2024. The committee adjusted the timing of several items and requested additional reports on specific program costs and legal fees.

items.title: FY25 Budget Calendar
items.summary: Director of Finance Gerry McCue presented the draft budget schedule, which includes a vote on May 6 and a public hearing on April 11.

items.title: Presentation and Report Schedule
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented a draft schedule of monthly reports through the end of the school year, including updates on the MSBA process, student achievements, and English learner enrollment.

items.title: Credit Recovery Program Report
items.summary: Approved a motion to require a report on the costs and demographics of students enrolled in the credit recovery program.

items.title: Special Education Legal Fees
items.summary: Approved a motion for an annual report on special education legal fees and hearing requests to be submitted to the committee by January 31 each year.

items.title: SEL Report Consolidation
items.summary: Approved a motion to consolidate two separate presentations regarding social-emotional learning into one comprehensive update.

items.title: Before and After School Program Update
items.summary: Approved moving the update to March 4 to ensure the committee can set tuition rates before the program lottery opens in April.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation
items.summary: Approved a motion to add the School Committee's formal evaluation of the Superintendent to the June 10 agenda.

items.title: Comprehensive Report List Review
items.summary: Approved a motion for Member McLaughlin to review the master list of dozens of historical report requests and recommend which should remain as full presentations or be shifted to written packet updates.
